name: Chrome
author: TurnOver
summary: Web pages in Chrome using TurnOver's shared Chromium browse and focus modes. Preview.
description: Chrome uses TurnOver's existing Chromium web reader, with browse-mode quick keys and focus mode for forms. This preview lists that shared support; it does not add a separate browser engine. Turn it on in Applications to try it.
privacy: Reads Chrome on your Mac; nothing is sent anywhere.

changes.notes: List the existing shared Chromium reader as a preview.
